name: toolprint
description: package-lock.json for MCP trust. Scan MCP servers and skill bundles for tool poisoning, secret leaks, and silent rug-pulls, and pin what you trust into a committed, reviewable toolprint.lock.

interface.shortDescription: Pin and verify the MCP tools your agent trusts
interface.longDescription: toolprint connects to your MCP servers, fingerprints every tool, prompt, resource, and skill definition into a committed toolprint.lock, and then catches silent changes (rug-pulls), hidden prompt-injection in tool text, and leaked credentials in configs. Two MCP tools: scan (read-only verify) and pin (update the lockfile after review).
defaultPrompt: Scan this project's MCP servers with toolprint and tell me what changed since the lockfile.
